text: 复杂项目模式是 DSH 的协作编码预设，通过 profile patch 安装 persona 规则和常用工具。它要求维护四类项目文档、只记录当前状态、未经明确授权不提交推送，并在编码前澄清目标、控制改动范围和验证结果。适合需要长期维护文档的复杂项目；需要 DSH 与 Node.js 指定版本，不需额外 API 配置。

Complex Project Mode adds documentation rules and tools to DSH through a profile patch. It guides assistants to clarify goals, keep changes focused, document current state, and avoid commits or pushes without explicit direction. For complex projects; requires the declared DSH and Node.js versions.

希望 AI 编码前先复述目标、假设和验收方式。
让 DSH 避免在我没明确同意时提交或推送代码。

I want a coding assistant to keep project docs focused on the current state.
Can DSH follow a careful workflow and avoid pushing without my approval?
复杂项目模式的功能「四文档项目文档」：规定项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步计划等文档职责，并要求只记录当前状态。通过 profile 中的复杂项目预设启用，作为 persona 规则或工具组合应用。
复杂项目模式的功能「谨慎编码工作流」：要求编码前澄清目标与完成标准，列出假设，只选简单方案，并进行小范围修改和验证。通过 profile 中的复杂项目预设启用，作为 persona 规则或工具组合应用。
复杂项目模式的功能「提交与推送约束」：要求用户自测通过并明确指示后，才执行 git commit、git push 或创建 PR。通过 profile 中的复杂项目预设启用，作为 persona 规则或工具组合应用。
复杂项目模式的功能「通俗进度汇报」：要求面向非专业用户用简单语言解释进度、结论与下一步。通过 profile 中的复杂项目预设启用，作为 persona 规则或工具组合应用。
复杂项目模式的功能「复杂项目工具栈」：在 preset 中组合文件、搜索、任务、技能、规划、工作流、网页等标准工具插件。通过 profile 中的复杂项目预设启用，作为 persona 规则或工具组合应用。
我想让 DSH 用大白话汇报修改结果和接下来的步骤。
Help me make an AI coding assistant follow a consistent workflow on a large project.

dsh-complex-project-preset README · dsh-complex-project-preset：**An agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the full standard tool stack, plus the discipline to think before it types.**

> 中文版: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

The whole preset lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml): it inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row into the profile and registers a preset with the id `complex-project`. The package ships **configuration only** — no host code, no browser UI — so there is very little that an upgrade can break.

---

dsh-complex-project-preset README · Why：The standard preset gets work done, but it will not hold a line on its own: diffs creep, project docs turn into changelogs, and code goes up before you said so.

This preset writes four rules into the persona prompt, so every session starts with them already in force:

dsh-complex-project-preset README · Why：| Rule | In one line |
| --- | --- |
| Four documents | A project keeps at most four docs: intro, decisions, change log, current state & next steps |
| Current state only | No AI edit history, no superseded decisions, no leftover "stage 1–5" wording |
| Commit/push red line | No `git commit`, `git push`, or PR until you explicitly say so |
| Careful coding + plain language | Restate the goal and the done-criteria first, make surgical diffs, lead reports with the conclusion |

dsh-complex-project-preset README · What's inside：The tool stack matches the standard preset — bash/pwsh chosen per platform, file read/write and search, tasks and background jobs, skills, plan mode, compaction, subagents and workflows, web fetch, the TODO tool, present. What differs is the persona prompt and the documentation rules:

dsh-complex-project-preset README · What's inside：> ⚠️ The persona block deliberately sets **no `suffix`**. DSH registers only `provider` and `model` as prompt variables; any other `{{name}}` throws during prompt assembly and the whole turn fails before a single request is sent. The working directory is injected by the runtime context already, so declaring it here is redundant as well as fatal.

text: dsh-complex-project-preset README · Version requirement：Requires **DSH ≥ 0.1.7-rc.2** (the preset registry `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry` joins the base composition there) and **Node.js ≥ 22.19.0**. Verified on DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 and on the desktop build 0.2.1-rc.2.

dsh-complex-project-preset README · Version requirement：The Node floor is the harness's own rather than this package's: DSH compositions call `process.getBuiltinModule`, which Node ships from 22.3 onwards. This package is a manifest plus one YAML patch — no host code, no browser code, no install-time scripts — so it never loads JavaScript of its own, and the floor only mirrors where DSH can run at all.

dsh-complex-project-preset README · Verify：After a restart, open the mode picker for a new session: **复杂项目模式** (order 2, right after the standard preset) should be listed. Start a session with it and ask about the project's current state — the answer should talk in terms of the four documents rather than freeform.

From the CLI you can also inspect the composed tree:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 preset-complex-project
```

dsh-complex-project-preset README · Develop：```sh
npm test          # checks manifest + cordis.patch.yml consistency, including !!js parsing
npm pack --dry-run
```

dsh-complex-project-preset README · Develop：`tools/smoke.mjs` verifies that `dsh.bundle.patch` points at a file that exists, that `repository` points back at this repo, that every required preset field is present, that child row ids are unique, and that the persona prompt is neither truncated nor carrying a stray `suffix`. It parses the patch with the harness's own `loadOverlayPatches` when available, so `!!js` expressions behave exactly as they do at boot.
